digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate code-grounding (det floor + G1G2/E4/E6 reviewers)
propositions: Plan-review grounding finders (G1G2/E4/E6) only ground against origin/main and false-positive-block plans relying on symbols a prerequisite ticket will create.
The G1G2 rule that a depends_on-created symbol is treated as existing was prose-only and unwired.
Introduce a machine-parseable inline citation grammar `<subject> [rebar:<ticket-id>]` referencing a relied-upon code element in an upstream ticket.

Layer 1 adds an advisory (never-blocking) det_citation check verifying the cited id is a direct upstream prerequisite via P.depends_on(C) or C.blocks(P) reverse lookup, failing closed on lookup errors.
Layer 2 has the reviewer retrieve the cited ticket via show_ticket and, only if coverage is affirmatively confirmed, credit the symbol and drop the finding; otherwise it fails closed.
A behavioral eval validates that verified+covered citations are credited while edge-unbacked or coverage-absent citations keep the missing-symbol finding standing.
